text:
Jordan: Heads up — EU GPU provisioning for account 987654-xyz is on hold. GCP emailed 'business verification required' and the payment attempt threw a 3DS decline. Blocking A100 pool for eu-west-1.
Alex: Which project ID and the exact GCP error?
Jordan: Project: rw-eu-prod (redacted). Email snippet from GCP: ```We cannot verify your business name against the provided tax ID. Billing attempt failed with 3DS authentication error. Please complete business verification and update payment method.```
Alex: Ugh. Is this the merchant name mismatch we've seen before?
Maia: Looks like it. FinOps checked: VAT reg doc uploaded yesterday, but payment gateway shows merchant_name != legal_name on file. Gateway refuses 3DS auth so GCP can't charge.
Sam: I started a support case with GCP (case 24680) but the ticket is marked 'awaiting customer action — business verification'.
cloud-ops: opened a quota request for eu-west-1 A100s but provisioning failed with code 402 due to billing hold. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/24680 (internal)
sre-bot: [alert] provisioning failure — project rw-eu-prod — attempt at 2026-03-17T10:12Z — status=FAILED_BILLING_HOLD
Jordan: This is blocking Dedicated onboarding for a customer test cohort — currently 3 queued jobs waiting for capacity.
Alex: Short-term mitigation: can we spin up a test pool in us-west and route only non-sensitive traffic? Cost hit for cross-region egress ~+15-25%.
Maia: I'll try to attach a backup corporate card and re-submit business verification with corrected name now. ETA 24-48h for gateway re-check.
FinOps: Confirmed we've requested merchant name update with the payment processor; they said propagation could take 24h. Also submitted additional proof (certificate of incorporation).
Sam: If this doesn't clear in 48h, propose we enable cross-region routing + update canary to point at us-west fallback. I'll draft playbook steps.
Alex: Also flag CS + Solutions so customers are aware of a potential region failover.
Jordan: Agreed. Please post updates here as they come.
Maia: Updating support case and pinging GCP rep now. Will post case number and any required forms. :thumbsup:
FinOps: I'll monitor charges and confirm once the gateway accepts the test authorization.
Jordan: Thanks — keeping this thread as source of truth for the EU provision hold. :raised_hands:
